claim: The first calendar quarter of 2025 net income result was around $2.1B at Adobe.
summary: Without tools/browsing the exact Adobe net income for the first calendar quarter of 2025 (Jan 1-Mar 31, 2025) cannot be verified from memory alone. Adobe's fiscal year does not align with calendar quarters, creating ambiguity between GAAP/non-GAAP and fiscal vs calendar reporting, and no evidence is available to support or contradict the ~$2.1B figure.

sub_claims.text: Adobe's net income for the first calendar quarter of 2025 (January 1 to March 31, 2025) was around $2.1 billion
sub_claims.note: No tool access to retrieve Adobe 10-Q/earnings release for calendar Q1 2025; cannot confirm GAAP vs non-GAAP net income or reconcile fiscal Q1 (Dec-Feb) vs calendar Q1 (Jan-Mar) without evidence.
